issues.problem: bad[1] (table and chair are inseparable) gave a false reason: natives do say objects are 形影不离 with a person (手机跟他形影不离), so 'not of objects' is untrue
issues.action: Replaced with a clear grammar misuse: 形影不离 used transitively with an object (形影不离他的女朋友)

issues.problem: bad[0] (cutting a watermelon 一刀两断) was not clearly wrong; the literal reading is transparent and the claim 'never literal' is too strong
issues.action: Replaced with a clear grammar misuse: 一刀两断了男朋友 with a direct object instead of 跟……一刀两断

issues.problem: ctx[4] (beating rivals just by cutting prices is too ___) fitted 异想天开 (cy161) equally well
issues.action: Rewrote it around a partnership only one side wants, which only 一厢情愿 fits

issues.problem: ctx[0] (hangover), ctx[1] (no umbrella, got soaked) and the cue (ate off seafood despite warnings) fitted 自讨苦吃 (cy157) as well: self-inflicted hardship rather than deserved consequences of wrongdoing
issues.action: Rewrote ctx[0] as drink-driving and losing the licence, ctx[1] as badmouthing people and being shunned, and the cue as cheating a classmate and being ostracised
